title: Indian Airforce Agniveer Vayu Intake 02/2027 Online Form – Last Date Today
vacancyDetails: Agniveervayu intake 02/2027 for unmarried male and female candidates under Agnipath scheme
qualification: 10+2 with Physics & Maths / equivalent or as per Science Subjects / other streams as in IAF notification; intermediate with 50% as applicable
ageLimit: 17.5 to 21/22 years as per intake 02/2027 notification (born within dates specified)
applicationFee: As per IAF Agniveervayu online registration (if any)
selectionProcess: Online Exam → Physical Fitness Test → Adaptability Tests → Medical Examination → Document Verification
documentsRequired: Educational certificates, photo ID (Aadhaar), passport photos, signature, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit https://iafrecruitment.edcil.co.in/agniveervayu/ or agnipathvayu.cdac.in
2. Register for Agniveervayu Intake 02/2027
3. Fill personal and educational details
4. Upload photo, sign and documents
5. Submit before 26 July 2026
shortDescription: IAF Agniveer Vayu Intake 02/2027 Online Form open 6–26 July 2026. Online exam expected 22–23 September 2026.
content:
Indian Air Force has opened registration for Agniveervayu Intake 02/2027.

Apply online from 6 July 2026 to 26 July 2026. Online examination tentatively on 22–23 September 2026.

  • Unmarried Indian male and female candidates eligible as per notification
  • Selection: Online test, PFT, adaptability, medical
  • Official portals: iafrecruitment.edcil.co.in / agnipathvayu.cdac.in
